question: India hosted Men’s Hockey World Cup in 2023 at:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhubaneswar and Rourkela**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhubaneswar and Rourkela** hosted the **Men's Hockey World Cup in 2023**.
 
• Bhubaneswar is the capital city of Odisha and is known for its rich history and cultural heritage.
 
• Rourkela is a prominent industrial city in Odisha, known for the **Rourkela Steel Plant**.
 
• The Kalinga Stadium in Bhubaneswar and the Biju Patnaik Hockey Stadium in Rourkela were the primary venues for the event.
 
• This was the second consecutive time that Bhubaneswar hosted the Men's Hockey World Cup, having previously hosted it in **2018**.
 
• The event saw participation from top hockey teams from around the world, competing for the prestigious title.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hockey India** is the governing body for field hockey in India and was responsible for organizing the event.
 
• The Men's Hockey World Cup is held every four years, with the **International Hockey Federation (FIH) **overseeing the tournament.
 
• India has a rich history in field hockey, having won multiple Olympic gold medals and World Cups.
 
• The 2023 edition of the Men's Hockey World Cup aimed to promote the sport further in the country and inspire future generations of hockey players.
 
• Odisha has been actively supporting hockey and has also sponsored the Indian national hockey teams since 2018.
